rationale: Artifact 2691189d satisfies AC-11 under a hostile end-to-end probe through the real built mindspec binary and its next --emit-only path. A PATH-prepended fake bd emitted the real schema-error text, ANSI ESC sequences, carriage return, SOH, and 100 stderr lines before exiting 1. The rendered command error preserved the schema-error line, converted the hostile line to printable escaped text, contained zero raw ESC/CR/SOH bytes, included stderr line 020, excluded line 021 and later lines, and emitted exactly one truncation marker naming the 20-line cap. Focused AC-11 tests and go test ./... -short passed. The bead-7 parallel track has no file overlap and does not change the QueryReady/error-rendering contract. The bead worktree remained clean at the reviewed SHA and the /tmp fixture was removed.

findings.title: Real next path safely renders hostile bd stderr
findings.evidence: mindspec next --emit-only resolved the PATH shim and exited 1 with the schema text intact; the hostile line rendered as quoted \x1b, \r, and \x01 text. A byte probe counted raw_SOH=0, raw_CR=0, raw_ESC=0.

findings.title: Twenty-line cap and marker are correct under 100-line stderr
findings.evidence: The rendered error included the schema line, hostile line, stderr-line-003 through stderr-line-020, omitted stderr-line-021, and included exactly one '... (stderr truncated at 20 lines)' marker.

findings.title: Verification and parallel-track isolation passed
findings.evidence: Focused bead/next AC-11 tests passed, go test ./... -short passed, and bead 9's four changed files are disjoint from bead 7's changes. Final HEAD was 2691189d751480eaacd3f9accee69bec9c8bd692 with no staged, unstaged, or untracked changes.
